ops.title: Tilskud til lys- og lydudstyr ved stævner
ops.reason: Both rules regulate the same subsidy to clubs for renting light and sound equipment at competitions; the board's February 2010 proposal was decided in March 2010 under the other rule.
Both regulate the subsidy paid to the organiser of divisionsturnering/DM-Hold rounds; the 2026 decision raising it to 5.000 kr. explicitly removed the 10.000-kr. scheme held by the other rule.
The decision lets national-team lifters book their own travel within the committee's travel budget, a national-team rule.
The procedure governs payments and receipts handed to the team manager before departure on national-team trips abroad.
